composition_notes: A measured triple dance gives weight to the second beat and space to the cadence.
A newly shaped upper cantabile replaces the sequence of root-based broken triads; accented scalar dissonances give the second beat its expressive weight, and the inner parts move economically.
The score records each added suspension and scalar connection explicitly for teaching.
The free preludes are reviewed for note integrity, spelling, harmonic context and the listed voice-leading changes; they are not advertised as strict-species exercises.
The first-inversion dominant bass resolves through a stepwise leading-note-to-tonic connection before its retained first-inversion tonic arrival.
